_doc: Launch presets (was PRESETS in layout.js). speed km/h; angle = heading toward the deck edge (deg); spin = angular kick from the broken kerb in car axes [pitch(+nose down), yaw, roll(+right side up)] rad/s, applied over kick.dur seconds once the centre of mass passes deck.halfWidth - kick.trigger; lead = seconds from t=0 until the centre of mass is 0.9 m short of the deck edge (it reaches the edge ~0.2 s later, the kick triggers 0.6 m before the edge). joints/strength only affect the soft body.
